purpose: First prospective positive-evidence gate for macro P/C jurisdiction after hierarchical abstention closure.

held_out_scope.type: held-out from macro P/C development sequence, not globally unseen

pairing.baseline: single base-model generation; same prompt and seed as C
pairing.P: L1=baseline seed; L2=seed+1000; L3_raw=seed+2000; L3_informed=seed+3000; A_P anti-regression adjudication
pairing.C: same baseline seed + TALM v0.5.2 mass_right_soft
pairing.rule: P abstention produces no W/T/L observation; C is never credited because P is absent.

outcome.WTL: WIN iff candidate exact-pass and baseline exact-fail; LOSS iff candidate exact-fail and baseline exact-pass; otherwise TIE

bayes.prior: Dirichlet(1,1,1) over WIN,TIE,LOSS independently by process/model and process/model/regime

task_regime_transportability.rule: within every represented regime, observed LOSS count must not exceed WIN count; each regime requires >=2 admissible observations

cross_model_transportability.rule: support passes in both model families and the aggregate observed WIN-LOSS sign does not reverse across model families

authority.rule: This gate may produce PROVISIONAL_JURISDICTION_EVIDENCE only. It cannot grant operational APPLY_P/APPLY_C authority.

claim_boundary: No claim of global unseen evaluation.
No human/LLM semantic judge is used; only frozen source validators.
No authority promotion from P/C availability.
Transportability is limited to the two frozen model families and three frozen prompts.
Operational authority remains prohibited after this gate.
